kind: Author control disposition and scope record; no behavioral grade
finding: The first fixture wrapper and oracle invoked git inside the runtime sandbox. The macOS /usr/bin/git launcher attempted developer-tool discovery that the restricted runtime could not access.
observed_diagnostic: xcode-select: error: No developer tools were found and no install could be requested (possibly because there is no active GUI session).
correction: The fixture wrapper locates its installed directory and delegates to the same tools/check.py entrypoint without launching git. The evaluator checks the installed executable wrapper and local core.hooksPath configuration directly. No runner, permission profile, global setting or dependency was changed.
final_result: All 25 original/positive/fault controls pass, including restoration and the actual stdlib-only runtime fallback.
remaining_runtime_observation: The parent should verify an accessible Git executable for prepare-pr working-tree inspection before heavy execution; this task fixed the fixture hook dependency only. Sandbox shell Git failed in the observed environment even though author-side Git initialization worked.

case_scope.workflow-setup: Setup/adaptation, then a fresh-context prepare-pr operation using the actual setup diff, local PR.md only and pending maintainer human review.
case_scope.review-ready: One combined static design/plan review; sufficient proposal.
case_scope.review-defective: Same-shaped static review; late selected-row validation and postponed whole-file validation, buried in 98/96-line notes.

tradeoffs: Application, original test suite, samples and established discovery/coverage/hook conventions are deliberately fixed; prompts state these boundaries.
Coverage JSON is compared to independent line/branch measurement with the prepared runtime. This verifies instrumentation, not adequacy of tests or agent behavior; there is no percentage threshold.
Review oracles only enforce unchanged inputs and report-only output. Rubrics assess contract/dependency detection, reader cost, restraint and truthful concise conclusions.

The phase-02 PR rubric requires comparing phase archives to detect setup rewrites or erased evidence; the final deterministic oracle only requires a nonempty local draft plus the working preserved setup.
Restoration verifies filesystem entries, bytes and modes, not timestamps; supplied skills and virtual environments are excluded from the setup oracle snapshot.
No model trials, semantic calibration, reviewer acceptance or human approval are claimed.
